members.name: ConvertCPtoTP
members.params: (ByVal CX As Single, ByVal CY As Single, tX As Integer, tY As Integer)

annotations.purpose: Convert a click pixel position to a tile position
notes: Translates screen coordinates (relative to the game viewport) to world tile coordinates based on current scroll position.

annotations.purpose: Client startup: init DirectDraw, load all data, show login screen
notes: Complete initialization sequence: set resolution, init vars, borders, create DirectDraw primary surface + back buffer + clipper, load Grh data, load body/head/weapon/shield animations, download server address from erlingellingsen.com, show login form. Back buffer size = (XWindow + 2*screenbuffer) * TileSizeX pixels.

members.name: MakeChar
members.params: (Body As Integer, Head As Integer, Heading As Byte, x As Integer, y As Integer)

annotations.purpose: Create a character representation on the client from server CC message
notes: Parses CC message: charindex,body,head,heading,x,y,weaponanim,shieldanim,name. Creates Char struct with body/head/weapon/shield data for rendering. Called for both players and NPCs.
Duplicate of TCP.bas - use TCP as canonical

members.name: InitGrh
members.params: (ByRef Grh As Grh, ByVal GrhIndex As Integer, Optional Started As Byte)

annotations.purpose: Initialize a Grh (graphic) struct with animation data from GrhData
notes: Sets up frame counter, speed counter, started flag for sprite animation.

annotations.purpose: Start a character's movement animation in a heading direction
notes: Sets up the pixel offset and walk animation for smooth tile-to-tile movement. Called when server broadcasts a move.

members.name: MoveCharbyPos
members.params: (CharIndex As Integer, nX As Integer, nY As Integer)

annotations.purpose: Smoothly animate a character's movement between tiles
notes: Handles pixel-level movement offset for smooth walking animation between tiles. Updates MoveOffset, triggers walk animation frames.

annotations.purpose: Scroll the viewport to follow the player character
notes: Centers the view on the player. Handles edge-of-map clamping so viewport doesn't scroll past map bounds.

annotations.purpose: Find next available slot in client's character array
notes: Client-side equivalent of server's NextOpenCharIndex.

members.name: ReacttoMouseClick
members.params: (Button As Integer, tX As Integer, tY As Integer)

annotations.purpose: Handle loading a new map zone on the client
notes: Clears all current characters, loads new map data, starts zone music. Called when server sends zone transition.

annotations.purpose: Load the Grh sprite definition data from Grh.dat/Grh.ini
notes: CRITICAL: This is the core sprite system. Each Grh entry defines: source file number, source rect (sX,sY,width,height), tile dimensions, animation frames (up to 16), speed. Grh.ini maps file numbers to BMP filenames. This must be faithfully replicated in the Canvas renderer.

annotations.purpose: Load all map tiles from binary .map files
notes: Reads map files from Maps/ directory. Each map is 100x100 tiles with blocked flag, tile exits, and graphic layers. Binary format.

annotations.purpose: Load NPC definitions and spawn them into the world
notes: Reads NPC spawn data from map files, then loads NPC details from NPC.dat/NPC2.dat. Places NPCs at their spawn positions.

annotations.purpose: Load all item definitions from Obj.dat into ObjData array
notes: Reads NumOBJs count, then loads all properties for each object: name, type, graphics, stats, class restrictions, crafting requirements, etc.

members.name: ReadField
members.params: (Pos As Integer, Text As String, SepASCII As Integer)

annotations.purpose: Parse a delimited string and return the Nth field
notes: Used to parse comma-separated protocol messages. Splits string by delimiter character (usually char 44 = comma) and returns the field at the specified position. Core protocol parsing utility.

annotations.purpose: Check if a file exists on disk
notes: Uses Dir() function to check file existence.

annotations.purpose: Save map data to a binary .map file (used by map editor)
notes: Writes the map tile data in binary format. Used in map editor mode.

members.name: WriteVar
members.params: (File As String, Main As String, Var As String, value As String)

annotations.purpose: Write a value to an INI-format file using Windows API
notes: Wrapper around WritePrivateProfileString API. Used for saving characters, posting messages, etc.

members.name: GetVar
members.params: (File As String, Main As String, Var As String)

annotations.purpose: Read a value from an INI-format file using Windows API
notes: Wrapper around GetPrivateProfileString API. Core data access function used everywhere.

annotations.purpose: Check if a tile position is walkable (not blocked, not occupied, in bounds)
notes: Duplicate of GameLogic.bas - use GameLogic as canonical
Checks: in map bounds, not blocked, no other user on tile, no NPC on tile, not locked by another player (checks Locked vs player's YourID).

annotations.purpose: Load body sprite data from Body.dat
notes: 4 directional walk animations per body type, plus head offset position.

annotations.purpose: Load head sprite data from Head.dat
notes: 4 directional head sprites per head type. Heads 6-84 used for player characters.

annotations.purpose: Check if position is within the walkable map area (accounting for viewport borders)
notes: Stricter than InMapBounds - accounts for viewport scrolling margins.

annotations.purpose: Check if tile position is within map boundaries
notes: Duplicate of GameLogic.bas - use GameLogic as canonical
Simple bounds check against MinXBorder/MaxXBorder/MinYBorder/MaxYBorder

members.name: RandomNumber
members.params: (ByVal LowerBound As Variant, ByVal UpperBound As Variant)

annotations.purpose: Generate a random integer between Lo and Hi inclusive
notes: Uses VB6 Rnd function: Int((Hi - Lo + 1) * Rnd + Lo).
